method: All 33 explicit-reference overview sheets and all 33 final output overview sheets opened and inspected. All 25 seam boards inspected: raw pixels alongside directional geometry for every one of 308 changed source boxes. Selected full pages and supplied ink-difference images enlarged. Exact unchanged-item checks are mechanical, not a claim the baseline is correct.
limitations: Not an independent human gold annotation or OCR accuracy evaluation. Unchanged pages were checked at overview scale, not every glyph. Changed seams were inspected individually; preserved outer edges may retain original row/endpoint defects. No held-out pages accessed.
